<thought>Analyzing the 13C NMR data, the low‑field signals (≈10‑30 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. Peaks at 26.90 ppm appear twice (two equivalent methyl carbons) and a peak at 26.18 ppm appears once, giving a total of three methyl carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
